Your Emotional Wellbeing is Our Shared Priority.

MITR, A Wellness body of IITM comprising of Faculty and Students trained appropriately with counselling skills and empathy to offer counselling to peers. We MITR are available in all departments, Hostels to enhance approachability. We go by the Motto:

“No one in the campus should be unattended in their emotional distress”

Message from Dean of Students

“At IIT Madras, we believe that academic excellence is deeply intertwined with emotional well-being. MITR stands as a testament to our collective responsibility—to listen without judgment, to support without hesitation, and to ensure every student thrives emotionally and academically.”

Prof. Sathyanarayana N Gummadi
Dean of Students, IIT Madras
Core Services & Initiatives

What We Do

MITR provides peer counselling to students in distress in collaboration with other external agencies available at IITM. MITR organizes Barefoot training for new team members with the Help of Wellness Centre. MITR conducts events to help ease the emotions pent up in students and also conduct surveys to enhance the quality of mental health resources available to students.

psychology

1. Peer Counselling & Support

We offer empathetic, active-listening peer counselling to students facing emotional distress, academic stress, or isolation. For specialized psychological needs, we seamlessly connect students with external agencies and professional counsellors at the IITM Wellness Centre.

  • check_circle 100% Confidential & Judgement-Free
  • check_circle Department & Hostel Peer Availability
school

2. Barefoot Training Program

In close collaboration with the IITM Wellness Centre and clinical psychologists, MITR organizes intensive Barefoot Training for all newly recruited student coordinators. This equips members with active listening techniques, crisis triage, and empathetic communication.

  • check_circle Expert Clinical Guidance
  • check_circle Mandatory Training for Every Hostel Lead
celebration

3. Events & De-stressing Workshops

MITR conducts periodic campus events, open mic nights, art workshops, and wellness jams designed specifically to help students release pent-up emotions, build resilience, and foster meaningful social connections across campus.

  • check_circle Annual Mindfulness & Resilience Summit
  • check_circle Hostel De-stressing Sessions
poll

4. Mental Health Surveys & Research

We conduct systematic campus-wide surveys to evaluate student mental health needs, assess resource availability, and provide actionable feedback to the IIT Madras administration to continuously elevate campus wellness infrastructure.

  • check_circle Data-Driven Policy Support
  • check_circle Quality Enhancement Reports

Recruitment & Selection Process

MITR team members are recruited every year in a very tedious manner. Applicants are screened and sorted via interviews. To ensure availability in each department, A student from each department and Hostel is recruited and are given barefoot training. The following is the Team’s vertical leads:

Step 1

Campus Screening

Tedious application screening evaluating empathy, active listening, and commitment.

Step 2

Multi-tier Interviews

In-depth personal interviews conducted by senior coordinators and advisors.

Step 3

Hostel & Dept Selection

Selection of dedicated coordinators representing every hostel and academic department.

Step 4

Barefoot Training

Intensive counselling skills training with professional psychologists before deployment.

5
